name: swarm-janitor
description: Every 3 minutes, closes the herdr tab of an idle agent whose worktree PR merged and has nothing uncommitted, and pushes your phone when an agent stays blocked

closeMerged.title: Close merged agents' tabs
closeMerged.description: Close the herdr tab of an idle or done agent once its worktree branch's PR is merged and the worktree has no uncommitted changes.

blockedMinutes.title: Minutes blocked before a phone push
blockedMinutes.description: An agent that waits for an answer this long gets one push through ~/.claude/bin/phone-notify.
